description.narrative: TI Georgia will aim to address these challenges by building pressure on the government to undertake reforms and developing policy solutions to be used during specific windows of opportunity. More specifically, TI Georgia aims to: (i) study specific areas of anti-corruption policy to identify shortcomings at the legal as well as practical level; (ii) develop policy recommendations (including policy briefs and draft laws) based on best practice; (iii) measure the overall health of the country’s integrity system by preparing the National Integrity System assessment; (iv) advocate evidence-based anti-corruption reform on the local and international level; (v) monitor and report on corruption related violations by public officials and their possible involvement in corruption schemes; and (vi) raise public awareness about corruption and its negative impact on society. Furthermore, as a solution to the key problem of rising high-level corruption, Transparency International Georgia will continue its efforts to advocate for the establishment of an independent anti-corruption service.
